name: El Pinacate and Gran Desierto de Altar Biosphere Reserve
story: El Pinacate and Gran Desierto de Altar Biosphere Reserve covers an area of 2,695.05 square kilometres in the Sonoran Desert in northwest Mexico. It is a UNESCO World Heritage Site featuring a volcanic shield, active dunes, and the highest concentration of Maar craters. NASA sent astronauts to train there for walking on the Moon.
matters: The reserve shelters threatened endemic species including the Sonoran pronghorn, bighorn sheep, gila monster, and desert tortoise. It forms part of a larger desert ecosystem that spans northwest Mexico and the southwestern United States.
